look.light: humid gold, soft contrast, a heavy warm haze

ishtar_gate.title: Ishtar Gate
ishtar_gate.text: Nebuchadnezzar's gate of about 575 BC, faced with blue glazed bricks bearing aurochs and the dragon mušḫuššu in relief; the procession of the spring festival passed through it.

processional_way.title: Processional Way
processional_way.text: The paved way from the Ishtar Gate south through the city, its walls faced with glazed bricks showing striding lions.

etemenanki.title: Etemenanki
etemenanki.text: Marduk's stepped temple tower beside his temple Esagila. How much of it stood under Xerxes is debated; it is shown standing.

babylon_scribe.title: Scribe
babylon_scribe.text: Babylon's temples and business houses kept their accounts in cuneiform on clay, and thousands of tablets survive.

winter_court.title: The king's winter
winter_court.text: Xenophon writes that the Persian king spent seven winter months in Babylon, three spring months at Susa and two summer months at Ecbatana. Other Greek writers say much the same. The court's moves are not described in any Persian record, so the game shows them as Greek writers say.

strings.first_visit: Babylon. The road enters by the blue gate of Ishtar.
strings.market_day: Market day: stalls, voices and goods from the country around.
strings.market_rain: Rain: the stallholders cover their goods and wait under the eaves.
strings.lamps_lit: Dusk: the lamps are lit along the street.
strings.wedding: A wedding: the bride is led to her new home with torches and songs.
strings.shearing: Shearing time: wool for the looms.
strings.early_market: The market opens at dawn, before the heat.
strings.harvest_in: The harvest is carried in to the stores.
strings.winter_fires: Fires in the doorways against the cold evening.
strings.king_in_babylon: Royal guards and banners at the palace: the court winters here, Greek writers say.
strings.date_harvest: Climbers in the palms cut the heavy clusters of dates.
strings.palm_pollination: Gardeners climb the palms to dust the female flowers.
strings.season_turn.spring: The storks are back on their nests.
strings.season_turn.apr: The river is rising over the low fields.
strings.season_turn.summer: The air shimmers over the land at noon.
strings.season_turn.autumn: Climbers in the palms: the date harvest.
strings.season_turn.winter: Cranes call high overhead, flying in a long V.

era.edge: The Persian empire of Xerxes · c. 470 BC
